ram_cache_observed.note: Counters include concurrent browsing and the temporary controller quarantine while fixes rolled out.

live_batch_performance.sampling_note: One-second sleep plus inspection overhead; CPU percentages use actual elapsed timestamps.

approval: User explicitly approved rollout and live measurement on 2026-10-17

worker_frame_live.decoder_limit: Transient systemd job 25% one CPU / 320 MiB enclosing Podman 0.25 CPU / 256 MiB; controller keeps its existing 15% / 96 MiB limit.
worker_frame_live.live_fix: Initial direct child inherited controller cgroup and timed out. Reused existing transient playback-job isolation pattern, retested 5 decoder cases, serial idle-only rollout to all three nodes.

playback_regression.result: Reached end after resolving while thumbnails were present; no new video download needed.

verification_limits: One-hour TTL and byte/entry eviction were verified with offline time-controlled tests, not a one-hour production wait or a forced 16 MiB production fill.
Worker decode measured on node 1; identical decoder hashes and readiness verified on nodes 2 and 3.
JPEG pixels, transport bytes, credentials and signed URLs were not persisted in measurement reports.
One-frame fallback is deliberately bounded and slower (about 18 seconds end-to-end in this sample); event JPEGs remain preferred.
